public_pre_readout_capabilities: ordinary program closure under repeated calls, storage, duplication and branching on equality

reflection_theorem.closure_algorithm: start from zero and public generators; repeatedly add all known handles and deduplicate by extensional equality until stable
reflection_theorem.completeness_reason: the supplied generators generate the carrier
reflection_theorem.presentation: one free integer generator e_x for every enumerated handle x; relations e_0 and e_x+e_y-e_(x+y)
reflection_theorem.isomorphism: Z^(carrier)/relations is canonically isomorphic to the opaque additive module
reflection_theorem.representation_dependency: none; only exported operations and equality are queried

support_corollary.fiber_dimension: dim_F_r(M tensor F_r) = number_of_columns - rank_F_r(A mod r)
support_corollary.semiprime_boundary: for N=pq, unequal p/q fiber dimensions imply unequal ranks of the reflected presentation
support_corollary.parent_theorem_reuse: the accepted explicit-presentation determinantal-divisor theorem then yields some k with 1 < gcd(N,D_k(A)) < N
support_corollary.consequence: ordinary finite opaque/lazy ADT wrapping does not delay scalarization

killed_routes: opaque wrapper around an explicit presentation
lazy thunk whose algebraic operations and equality remain callable
finite black-box module with public generators, addition and extensional equality
implementation secrecy that merely declines to run the reflection algorithm
surviving_requirements: remove unrestricted replay/duplication/composition of handles, or
scope_exclusions: oracle or physical hidden resources not computable from public N alone
non-module typed states whose support is not presentation/Fitting support

observations: reflection presentation for Z/3 has maximal determinantal divisor 3 and ranks 2 mod 3, 3 mod 5
reflection presentation for Z/5 has maximal determinantal divisor 5 and ranks 5 mod 3, 4 mod 5
